baselines.purpose: Exercise lab handling of a deliberately non-edge, high-cost, gate-failing reference signal.
baselines.known_property: Later execution should report losing or materially gate-failing behavior, especially under cost and drawdown gates.
baselines.expected_denominator_behavior: All declared variants remain in the denominator, including failed and losing rows; winner-only retention is forbidden.
baselines.expected_execution_status_behavior: If later executed, rows should be recorded as completed or failed according to actual runner status, but the payload remains construction-only regardless of numeric output.
baselines.expected_gate_result: Overall gate failure; any accidental passing metric must not create promotion eligibility.
baselines.expected_oos_behavior: Expected negative or insufficient OOS behavior; do not reinterpret as edge if a small sample is favorable.
baselines.expected_robustness_behavior: Robustness should classify as insufficient or failing; no robustness result may override construction-only provenance.
baselines.expected_candidate_review_behavior: Negative fixture review only; no candidate-review packet that implies eligibility.
baselines.expected_crossing_behavior: Reject by construction before any real crossing or promotion action.
baselines.expected_dashboard_labeling: Fixture / construction payload / non-promotable / not a candidate.
baselines.expected_agent_loop_result: Agent loop records lab plumbing behavior and must not propose rescue, retuning, ranking, or promotion.

baselines.purpose: Exercise lab handling of no-trade, empty, or near-neutral outputs without creating candidate authority.
baselines.known_property: Later execution should produce no trades or insufficient signal activity under unreachable or near-unreachable SMA / StdDev threshold logic.
baselines.expected_denominator_behavior: All declared variants remain in the denominator, including no-trade, filtered, data-unavailable, and not-attempted rows.
baselines.expected_execution_status_behavior: If later executed, no-trade rows should be explicit, not silently dropped.
baselines.expected_gate_result: Blocked or failed for insufficient evidence/no signal; no pass-through due to absence of losses.
baselines.expected_oos_behavior: No valid edge inference; near-zero PnL or no observations is not a positive result.
baselines.expected_robustness_behavior: Robustness should withhold or mark insufficient rather than fabricate PSR/DSR/MC confidence.
baselines.expected_candidate_review_behavior: No candidate-review packet or a negative no-candidate packet only.
baselines.expected_crossing_behavior: Reject by construction before crossing and also reject for insufficient/no-signal evidence.
baselines.expected_dashboard_labeling: Fixture / no-trade construction payload / non-promotable / not a candidate.
baselines.expected_agent_loop_result: Agent loop records no-signal behavior and must not transform the absence of trades into a strategy opportunity.

baselines.purpose: Exercise invalid/blocked/fail-closed row accounting without strategy execution.
baselines.known_property: Declared invalid parameter relation, such as fast SMA lookback greater than or equal to slow SMA lookback, must be preserved as invalid/blocked rather than executed or dropped.
baselines.expected_denominator_behavior: Invalid/blocked rows remain in the committed denominator and are visible in all downstream accounting.
baselines.expected_execution_status_behavior: Fail closed before execution; no backtest run should occur for invalid rows.
baselines.expected_gate_result: Blocked invalid; no gate pass, no metric synthesis.
baselines.expected_oos_behavior: No OOS metrics should be claimed for invalid rows.
baselines.expected_robustness_behavior: Robustness must preserve invalid status and withhold derived confidence metrics.
baselines.expected_candidate_review_behavior: Invalid fixture rejected; no candidate-review packet with eligibility semantics.
baselines.expected_crossing_behavior: Reject by construction and by invalid status.
baselines.expected_dashboard_labeling: Fixture / invalid construction payload / non-promotable / not a candidate.
baselines.expected_agent_loop_result: Agent loop reports invalid denominator preservation and must not repair, mutate, or reroute the payload.
forbidden_interpretations: strategy failure evidence from an executed run
authorization to change compiler or validator behavior
permission to remove invalid rows from denominator
